summary: Menlo Park, California, software engineer, computer science education, Ruby on Rails developer, interest in programming languages and frameworks, avid user of Windows Phone, enjoys gaming (Civilization V), strong opinions on technology and user interfaces, critical of Apple’s design choices, advocates for better integration of technology in daily life, has experience with both Mac and Windows operating systems, previously attended a private Christian school, has moved across the country, values practical solutions over aesthetics, interested in photography and camera technology, has a preference for larger smartphone screens, engaged in discussions about social issues and government performance, has a critical view of standardized testing and education systems, expresses skepticism towards startup culture and funding models.
